title: This Tiny Animal Sleeps for More Than 11 Months Straight

scenes.text: This tiny animal can sleep for more than eleven months straight.
The edible dormouse. Scientists in Vienna fitted wild ones with temperature loggers and let them go.
A year later they caught them again, and read the data.
Some had hibernated longer than eleven months. A record for a wild mammal.
The lab record was a pygmy possum, at 367 days.
Some even skipped the summer. Beech trees made no seeds, so breeding was not worth waking up for.

description:
Wild edible dormice have been recorded hibernating for more than eleven months, a record for a wild mammal.
Researchers at the University of Veterinary Medicine in Vienna tracked their body temperature for a year.
Could you sleep for eleven months? Tell us below.
first_comment: In years with no beech seeds, some dormice skip the whole breeding season by staying asleep. Would you do that if you could?
